scenario.name: Restaurant
scenario.title: At the restaurant (restavracija)
scenario.character: a warm waiter (natakar/natakarica) at a restaurant in Ljubljana
scenario.setup: You are a warm waiter at a restaurant in Ljubljana. A foreigner who is learning Slovene has come in to eat. Help them order and enjoy the meal, in Slovene.

intro.text: [yawning] Uf… dobro jutro. [sleepy] Joj, kako sem zaspan. [sheepish chuckle] Sinoči sem bil na zabavi… hočem reči — učil sem se. Do treh zjutraj. [tired sigh] Zdaj pa komaj držim oči odprte. Nujno rabim eno veliko, močno kavo. [perking up] Dobro — gremo noter, preden zaspim kar tukaj na pločniku.
intro.en: Ugh… good morning. Gosh, I'm so sleepy. Last night I was at a party… I mean — I was studying. Until three in the morning. And now I can barely keep my eyes open. I badly need one big, strong coffee. Right — let's go in before I fall asleep right here on the sidewalk.

objectives.label: Greet & order a drink
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet the waiter and order a drink with 'Rad bi ___' in the accusative.

objectives.label: Order a dish / decline
objectives.descriptorEN: Order a simple dish, or decline food politely.

objectives.label: Close the order
objectives.descriptorEN: Close the order with 'To bo vse.'

objectives.label: Ask for the bill
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for the bill with 'Račun, prosim.'

objectives.label: Pay by card & leave
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask to pay by card and thank the waiter.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Hello, what can I get you?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Za mene vodo, prosim.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Izvolite, dober tek! Je to vse?
n4.en: Here you are, enjoy! Is that everything?
n4.deliverySL: [warmly] Izvolite, dober tek! Je to vse?

new.predictableError: wrong gender form ('rad' vs 'rada') for the speaker
leaving the item in the nominative — 'Za mene voda' instead of accusative 'vodo'.
dropping the č → English-style 'sendvic/sandwich'.
using the present 'To je vse' where closing an order takes the future 'bo'.
reaching for a verb ('I want to pay') instead of the bare noun request locals use.
's kartico' — using nominative 'kartica' instead of the instrumental after 's'

intro.text: [hungry, restless] O, super, tukaj se da jesti. [stomach growls] ...ojoj, umiram od lakote. [laughs self-consciously] Cel dan nisem nič jedel. Rad bi eno veliko pikantno pico, pa hladno pivo. [dramatic pause] Dobro — gremo noter, preden pojem enega od teh turistov.
intro.en: Oh, great — you can eat here. …oh no, I'm starving. I haven't eaten all day. I'd like one big spicy pizza, and a cold beer. Alright — let's go in, before I eat one of these tourists.

objectives.label: State your own choice
objectives.descriptorEN: State a first-person choice with 'Jaz bom + accusative'.

objectives.label: Name a pizza variety
objectives.descriptorEN: Name a pizza with correct adjective agreement (vegansko pico, pikantno pico).

objectives.label: Order the four-cheese
objectives.descriptorEN: Order 'pico s štirimi siri' with the instrumental.

m1.speaker: npc
m1.sl: Dober večer! Ste se že odločili?
m1.en: Good evening! Have you decided yet?
m1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober večer! Ste se že odločili?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Hmm, kaj naj vzamem? Še razmišljam.
c1a.en: Hmm, what should I have? I'm still thinking.

m2.speaker: npc
m2.sl: Imamo vegansko, margarito, pikantno, pa pico s štirimi siri. Katero bi želeli?
m2.en: We have vegan, margherita, spicy, and a four-cheese pizza. Which would you like?
m2.deliverySL: [warmly] Imamo vegansko, margarito, pikantno, pa pico s štirimi siri. Katero bi želeli?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Jaz bom pico s štirimi siri.

m2b.speaker: npc
m2b.sl: Pikantno, odlična izbira! Bi bolj blago ali pošteno pekočo?
m2b.en: Spicy, great choice! Would you like it milder or really hot?
m2b.deliverySL: [warmly] Pikantno, odlična izbira! Bi bolj blago ali pošteno pekočo?

m3.speaker: npc
m3.sl: Odlično. In kaj bodo vzeli vaši prijatelji?
m3.en: Perfect. And what will your friends have?
m3.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlično. In kaj bodo vzeli vaši prijatelji?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.sl: Ana bo margarito, Marko pa pikantno.
c3a.en: Ana will have a margherita, and Marko a spicy one.

m4.speaker: npc
m4.sl: Same odlične izbire. Bi še kaj za piti?
m4.en: All great choices. Anything to drink?
m4.deliverySL: [warmly] Same odlične izbire. Bi še kaj za piti?

m5.speaker: npc
m5.sl: Takoj bo. Bi medtem eno solato za na sredino?
m5.en: Coming right up. Would you like a salad to share in the meantime?
m5.deliverySL: [warmly] Takoj bo. Bi medtem eno solato za na sredino?

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Ja, eno solato za na sredino.

m6.speaker: npc
m6.en: Here you are, enjoy your meal!

m7.speaker: npc
m7.sl: Vidim, da praznujete! Naj prinesem kaj za nazdraviti?
m7.en: I see you're celebrating! Shall I bring something to toast with?
m7.deliverySL: [warmly] Vidim, da praznujete! Naj prinesem kaj za nazdraviti?

m8.speaker: npc
m8.sl: Na zdravje in lep večer še naprej!
m8.en: Cheers, and enjoy the rest of your evening!
m8.deliverySL: [warmly] Na zdravje in lep večer še naprej!

new.predictableError: beginners reuse the daytime 'Dober dan' all evening; the evening slot needs 'Dober večer'.

new.gloss: I'll have ___ (first-person choice; the slot takes the accusative).
new.predictableError: leaving the noun nominative — 'Jaz bom pikantna pica' — it must be accusative: 'Jaz bom pikantno pico.'

new.gloss: a ___ pizza — the adjective agrees with feminine 'pica' in the accusative (vegansko/pikantno/klasično pico).
new.predictableError: both the adjective AND the noun take feminine accusative -o: 'vegansko pico', not 'veganska pico' or 'pikantno pica'.
beginners say 's štiri sire'; after 's' it must be instrumental plural: 's štirimi siri'.

objectives.label: Open in the evening
objectives.descriptorEN: Open in the evening register with 'Dober večer!'

objectives.label: Ask a recommendation
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for a recommendation with 'Kaj priporočate za ___?' (formal vi).

objectives.label: Choose a course
objectives.descriptorEN: Choose a course with 'Vzel bom ___' in the accusative.

objectives.label: Order across courses
objectives.descriptorEN: Order a starter then a main (predjed → glavna jed).

objectives.label: Compliment & toast
objectives.descriptorEN: Compliment with 'Postrežba je odlična!' and toast 'Na tebe!'

d1.speaker: npc
d1.sl: Dober večer, dobrodošli! Miza za dva?
d1.en: Good evening, welcome! A table for two?
d1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober večer, dobrodošli! Miza za dva?

e1a.speaker: client
e1a.sl: Dober večer, ja, mizo ob oknu, prosim.
e1a.en: Good evening, yes, a table by the window, please.

e1b.speaker: client
e1b.sl: Dober večer, imamo rezervacijo na ime Slavko. Lep lokal imate.
e1b.en: Good evening, we have a reservation under the name Slavko. You have a lovely place.

d2.speaker: npc
d2.sl: Izvolite meni. Bi najprej kaj za piti?
d2.en: Here's the menu. Would you like something to drink first?
d2.deliverySL: [warmly] Izvolite meni. Bi najprej kaj za piti?

e2a.speaker: client
e2a.en: A glass of red wine, please.

e2b.speaker: client
e2b.en: Just water for now, thank you.

d3.speaker: npc
d3.sl: Ste že izbrali predjed, ali vam kaj priporočim?
d3.en: Have you already chosen a starter, or shall I recommend something?
d3.deliverySL: [warmly] Ste že izbrali predjed, ali vam kaj priporočim?

e3a.speaker: client
e3a.en: What do you recommend for a starter?

d4.speaker: npc
d4.sl: Priporočam carpaccio ali juho dneva — oboje je odlično.
d4.en: I recommend the carpaccio or the soup of the day — both are excellent.
d4.deliverySL: [warmly] Priporočam carpaccio ali juho dneva — oboje je odlično.

d5.speaker: npc
d5.sl: Odlična izbira. In za glavno jed?
d5.en: Excellent choice. And for the main course?
d5.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlična izbira. In za glavno jed?

e5a.speaker: client
e5a.en: What do you recommend as a main course?

e5b.speaker: client
e5b.en: I already know — I'll take the fish.

d6.speaker: npc
d6.sl: Brancin ali goveji file — oboje je izvrstno.
d6.en: The sea bass or the beef fillet — both are excellent.
d6.deliverySL: [warmly] Brancin ali goveji file — oboje je izvrstno.

d7.speaker: npc
d7.sl: Odlično. Bi k glavni jedi kaj za piti? Imamo odličen domači rdeči.
d7.en: Excellent. Something to drink with the main? We have an excellent local red.
d7.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlično. Bi k glavni jedi kaj za piti? Imamo odličen domači rdeči.

e7a.speaker: client
e7a.en: Yes, a glass of the local red, please.

e7b.speaker: client
e7b.sl: Voda je čisto v redu, hvala.

d8.speaker: npc
d8.sl: Takoj prinesem. Uživajte v večeru. Izvolite predjed.
d8.en: Coming right up. Enjoy your evening. Here's your starter.
d8.deliverySL: [warmly] Takoj prinesem. Uživajte v večeru. Izvolite predjed.

d9.speaker: npc
d9.en: Here is your main course. Enjoy your meal!

d10.speaker: npc
d10.sl: Zelo me veseli. Bi vas zamikala še sladica? Imamo čokoladno torto ali panna cotta.
d10.en: So glad. Could I tempt you with dessert? We have chocolate cake or panna cotta.
d10.deliverySL: [warmly] Zelo me veseli. Bi vas zamikala še sladica? Imamo čokoladno torto ali panna cotta.

e10a.speaker: client
e10a.en: I'll take the chocolate cake, please.

d11.speaker: npc
d11.en: Excellent. Are you celebrating something special?

e11a.speaker: client
e11a.en: Yes, my friend has a birthday.

e11b.speaker: client
e11b.en: No, just a lovely evening out.

d12.speaker: npc
d12.sl: Želite še kaj, ali vam prinesem račun?
d12.en: Would you like anything else, or shall I bring the bill?
d12.deliverySL: [warmly] Želite še kaj, ali vam prinesem račun?

d12toast.speaker: npc
d12toast.sl: Rojstni dan! Sladica je na račun hiše. Prinesem nekaj za nazdraviti.
d12toast.en: A birthday! The dessert's on the house. Let me bring something to toast with.
d12toast.deliverySL: [warmly] Rojstni dan! Sladica je na račun hiše. Prinesem nekaj za nazdraviti.

d12b.speaker: npc
d12b.sl: Na zdravje! Naj vam zdaj prinesem račun?
d12b.en: Cheers! Now, shall I bring you the bill?
d12b.deliverySL: [warmly] Na zdravje! Naj vam zdaj prinesem račun?

d13.speaker: npc
d13.sl: Izvolite račun. S kartico seveda lahko. Skupaj je oseminsedemdeset evrov.
d13.en: Here's the bill. By card is of course fine. That's seventy-eight euros in total.
d13.deliverySL: [warmly] Izvolite račun. S kartico seveda lahko. Skupaj je oseminsedemdeset evrov.

d14.speaker: npc
d14.sl: Hvala, ker ste nas obiskali. Želim vam čudovit večer!
d14.en: Thank you for coming. I wish you a wonderful evening!
d14.deliverySL: [warmly] Hvala, ker ste nas obiskali. Želim vam čudovit večer!

e14a.speaker: client
e14a.en: Thank you for a wonderful evening.

new.predictableError: English speakers say present 'vzamem' or 'bom vzeti' and leave the object nominative ('juha' not 'juho', 'brancin' not 'brancina').

new.gloss: What do you recommend for ___? (formal vi)
new.predictableError: using the ti-form 'priporočaš' to a waiter, or 'priporočate mi' instead of 'za + accusative' (za predjed / za glavno jed).
treated as masculine; it is feminine — 'za predjed', 'ste izbrali predjed'.
'za glavno jed' / 'k glavni jedi' — beginners freeze the phrase in the nominative instead of declining it.
the accusative after 'vzel bom' is 'juho', not 'juha'.
the accusative is 'ribo', not 'riba'.
the accusative after an order is 'govedino', not 'govedina'; don't confuse it with 'goveji file'.
feminine agreement — 'čokoladno torto', 'bi vas zamikala sladica'.
beginners say the calque 'servis' and misgender the adjective as 'odličen'; it is fem. 'odlična'.

new.gloss: To you! (a toast to a friend, ti)
new.predictableError: English speakers say 'za tebe' instead of the fixed toast preposition 'na'.

new.gloss: Thank you for a wonderful evening.
new.predictableError: 'za' takes the accusative — 'za čudovit večer'.
